known_parity_gaps: check_checkpoint stops at the first non-empty family that would call make_finding. Python runs every family and sorts the combined list.
check_checkpoint drops earlier families when a later family has rows. Python sorts the combined list and may append one overflow finding.
A float or list used where Python would call str is a typed error. Rust does not invent the Python repr.
A seq string of Unicode digits is a typed error. Python str.isdigit accepts Unicode Nd.
